rules.statement: A court in a partition action has the power to exclude a separate lot wrongly included by a plaintiff as part of the corpus, and to declare the owner of the separate lot in an interlocutory decree.
rules.supporting_quote: In an action instituted under section 2 of the Partition Act to partition land the Court has inherent power, under section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code, to make an order excluding a separate or divided lot or land which has been wrongly included by the plaintiff as being part of the corpus
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 2 of the Partition Act and section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code
